title: Rigidity of maps into a smooth pullback resolution level
statement: Let L be a linear order, S and T rational resolution inputs, h:T->S smooth, A and B labeled ordinary resolution towers, and c:Comparison h A B as in [def-trf-labeled-ordinary-resolution-descent-data, def-trf-ordinary-resolution-rule]. For every original level i, every morphism f:B_{c.count(i)}->A_i whose composite with A_i->S equals B_{c.count(i)}->T->S equals c.levelMap(i).

proof.text: Induct over transitions of the ordinary tower. At an identity transition there is nothing to prove. At a successor factor through the specified blowup isomorphism and blowup map; an invertible ideal remains invertible by [lemma-nagata-cartier-total-transform-blowup] and by flat pullback along the isomorphism [lem-pc-flat-pullback-effective-cartier-ideal].

The center I_k becomes invertible on its own blowup by [thm-nagata-blowup-principalizes-center]. The first step propagates it to every level j with k+1 <= j, and flat pullback preserves it. For a flat map p:P->A_j, prove by induction on i<=j that any f:P->A_i over the same base map equals p followed by the transition j->i. At i=0 cancel the initial isomorphism. At i=k+1 apply the induction hypothesis to the two maps to A_k, and apply uniqueness in [thm-nagata-blowup-universal-property] to their lifts, since the pullback center ideal just proved invertible is the same for both.

The specified comparison square makes c.levelMap i the base change of the smooth base map. It is flat by smoothness and stability of flatness under base change. Apply the preceding uniqueness lemma with p=c.levelMap i and j=i, and simplify the identity transition.

proof_origin.place: VIII 2.1.9 and 2.3.4--2.3.5(ii), printed pp.88,91--92; W2 expansion using the proved ordinary blowup universal property.

from.place: Original descended-comparison proof Steps 1--6 (single-map gluing) and Steps 7--8 (identity/composition), ILO VIII 2.1.9 and 2.3.4--2.3.5. This node isolates the uniqueness of level maps used for coherence and overlap agreement.

lean.statement:
theorem smoothComparison_levelMap_unique
    {L : Type w} [LinearOrder L] (S T : RationalResolutionInput.{u})
    (h : T.scheme ⟶ S.scheme) [Smooth h]
    (A : LabeledTower L S.scheme) (B : LabeledTower L T.scheme)
    (c : Comparison h A B) (i : Fin (A.tower.length + 1))
    (f : B.tower.level (c.count i) ⟶ A.tower.level i)
    (hf : f ≫ A.tower.toBase i = B.tower.toBase (c.count i) ≫ h) :
    f = c.levelMap i
